item.title: Simple Sprout Shop Logo

turns.text: Make a square logo for my plant shop, Little Sprout. Just a simple green sprout above the name on white, nothing fancy.

item.tests: Produces a usable simple logo combining a clear mark and a readable business name.

answer_sheet.Mark and style: A simple green sprout above the name; clean and unfussy.

must_haves: A recognizable, simple green sprout sits above the name.
The square image contains a flat logo, not a photograph or merchandise mockup.

turns.text: Could you make a logo for my plant shop? I've been thinking about this little shop a lot, so getting a logo made feels like an exciting step. The shop is called Little Sprout, and I want the logo to be square. For the design, just put a simple green sprout above the name on a white background, nothing fancy. I'm probably over-explaining because the whole thing means a lot to me.
